description.value: Waters Edge Shoreside Suites occupies its own small spit of land within Ucluelet Harbour, offering self-contained condo suites with full kitchens, private entrances, and many featuring outdoor soaker tubs on decks overlooking the inlet and marina. The property sits minutes from the Wild Pacific Trail and serves as a natural launching point for Pacific Rim National Park, storm watching, and marine wildlife tours. An on-site Aveda day spa adds a distinctive amenity for guests looking to recover after time on the road.
